facts.fact: L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, says intra-UEMOA e-money transfers made up 7.25% of the value of Burkina Faso's mobile money transactions in 2024.
L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, puts intra-UEMOA transfers at 7.25% of the value of Burkina Faso's 20,139,735 million FCFA of e-money transactions in 2024.
